comparison_statistic_boundary: Signed difference divided by separately sourced experimental expanded U; not a z score, p-value, or combined experimental+numerical+calibration uncertainty En.

experimental_roles.length: Lane AMMT-20 us thermography class means; A/B/C frame counts 19/10/7 (not independent specimens)
experimental_roles.width_depth: Current exact NIST Section 2 Table 2 targets from AMMT-100 us traces; A/B/C 3/3/4 independent tracks. Lane Table 4 class W/D combines AMMT-100 and AMMT-20 us measurements and reports integer means.
experimental_roles.uncertainty: Lane Tables 5-7 U=2*uc, components in quadrature without correlations; separate from NIST class SD and from standard uncertainty of mean.
experimental_roles.joint_operator_limit: Length and W/D are class comparisons, not same-track simultaneous 3D measurements.

source.locator: Section 2, Table 2, Class Width and Class Depth columns; trace rows 1-10

width_depth_primary_provenance.aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean and sample SD across displayed trace means reproduce Table 2 class values to display precision. NIST text calls them class mean and standard deviation; raw microscope picks and exact pre-display precision are not published here.

c_depth_conflict.assessment: The current official primary table directly supports 29.6. Kollmannsberger 29.5 is a conflicting secondary transcription or earlier-release possibility; its cause is undocumented. Lane 30 is an integer display consistent with 29.6 but does not establish the earlier decimal.

limitations: No original microscope control-software measurements or manually selected boundary coordinates in the page
Displayed trace values are rounded; exact pre-display aggregation cannot be proven
Class SD is across trace means and is not Lane 2020 expanded measurement uncertainty U(k=2)

limits: Not material-property identification or true liquid-temperature validation.

factorial.mechanism_claim_as_recorded: Within fixed-B scalar conduction-latent model, k continuation chiefly drives joint rear-tail growth, cp partly opposes it; rearTs/Tl translate rather than phase-band significantly thickening. No trueproperty, shapevalidation, or flow claim.

current_claim_status_as_recorded.physical_scope: Literature-conditioned conduction/phase-change research and model-discrepancy diagnosis

constant_property_analytic_geometry.limitation: Surface uniform-core face averages assumed; actual iso edges are inside uniform core. W/D from surface/symmetry under this constant-property monotone reference, not general metallography component audit.

steady_transient_retained_comparison.limitation: Oldnative h10 has unresolved spatial/surface/crossingphaseerror; differenty0 and halfcell surface reconstruction. Agreement supports rough localstationaryapproximation only, doesnotprove maturedsteadyframeworknumericalaccuracy or physicalvalidation.
